# Segue Core test data

This directory contains two kinds of test data: synthetic audio generated by `generate_fixtures.py`, and `expected.json`, which holds analysis results from the legacy implementation (`core/legacy`, used by the Flutter app).

## Regenerating the audio

Requires Python 3 and ffmpeg on PATH. The script uses only the Python standard library. The committed files were generated on WSL (Ubuntu) with ffmpeg 8.0.1.

```bash
python3 core/testdata/generate_fixtures.py
```

With the same ffmpeg, the output is byte-identical on every run. The encoded files (mp3, ogg, opus, flac, m4a) depend on the ffmpeg and encoder versions, so a different ffmpeg may produce different bytes. If they change, regenerate `expected.json` as well.

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `click120_aminor_44k_stereo.{wav,mp3,ogg,opus}` | Compared with the legacy results in `expected.json` (different formats; opus is resampled from 48kHz) |
| `chords96_cmajor_48k_stereo.flac` | Compared with the legacy results in `expected.json` (resampled from 48kHz) |
| `click100_dminor_44k_mono.m4a` | Compared with the legacy results in `expected.json` (mono) |
| `clip_lr_44k_stereo.wav` | Clipping detection |
| `surround51_44k.flac` | Multichannel downmix |
| `tiny_2000_mono.wav` / `odd_length_stereo.wav` | Frame count definition |
| `empty_stereo.wav` / `not_audio.mp3` | Decode failures |
| `corrupt_middle.mp3` | File corrupted mid-stream (corrupt packets are skipped and decoding continues) |
| `silence_31min.opus` | 30-minute cap |
